sql: select (select count(*) from paper_positions where strategy='Cmmsell10' and status='open') as open_positions, (select count(*) from live_orders where strategy='Cmmsell10' and status='rejected' and created_at > now() - interval '3 hours') as rejects_3h, (select max(created_at)::text from live_orders) as last_order, (select count(*) from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at > now() - interval '15 minutes') as cands_15m, now()::text as now_utc
